name: Cable Alternating Shoulder Press
steps: Stand tall between two low pulleys on a cable machine, gripping a handle in each hand at shoulder height with forearms upright.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Press one handle straight overhead until that arm extends while keeping the opposite handle steady at your shoulder.
Lower the raised handle slowly back to shoulder height, then press the other arm, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your ribs stacked over your pelvis rather than leaning sideways or backward as each arm presses.
Position the cables smoothly behind your forearms so they do not rub across your shoulders.
